title: Sisense Failures by Dashboard
app: Sisense usage analytics and build logs via the Sisense REST API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sisense:audit event="build.failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by dashboard_id
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Sisense failures grouped by dashboard so operators immediately see which specific dashboards are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Sisense is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Sisense failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical dashboards.
visualization: Table of dashboard by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Sisense are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
